title: Outlier Introduces AI Powered Automated Business Analysis Platform
主要内容: Outlier, an AI-powered Automated Business Analysis platform, introduced its first AI-powered cross-platform Root Cause Analysis feature. This tool enables users to automatically identify key insights about business changes and their likely root causes. The feature integrates with SQL and cloud services such as Amazon Redshift Spectrum, Apache Druid, and Google Ads, supporting multiple data storage systems like Druid, PostgresQL, and MySQL. It helps organizations reduce the time required to uncover insights and resolve issues. Outlier was recognized as a 2018 Cool Vendor in Analytics by Gartner for its innovative approach to analytics.
